options.content: Physical exchange account data from persisted snapshots. Account balances come from PrivateStateSnapshot (REST wallet poll on private:state:{exchange}:snapshot). Per-symbol trading inventory, locked funds, and open orders come from VenueLedgerSnapshot (ledger:snapshot:{exchange}). This is separate from the virtual strategy wallet shown in Portfolio And PnL.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(e.ts)))::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'PrivateStateSnapshot'
  AND e.topic LIKE 'private:state:%:snapshot'
  AND COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)

panels.title: Private snapshot age
panels.description: Seconds since the latest PrivateStateSnapshot in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$'), 'unknown'), COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol', 'unknown'))
    COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$'), 'unknown') AS exchange,
    COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol', 'unknown') AS symbol,
    e.ts,
    e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'VenueLedgerSnapshot'
  AND e.topic LIKE 'ledger:snapshot:%'
  AND COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$'), 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$'), 'unknown'), COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol', 'unknown'), e.ts DESC
)
SELECT sum(jsonb_object_length(COALESCE(payload->'open_orders', '{}'::jsonb)))::double precision AS value
FROM latest

panels.title: Latest open orders
panels.description: Open order count from the latest VenueLedgerSnapshot per exchange/symbol.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown'))
    COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown') AS exchange,
    e.ts,
    e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'PrivateStateSnapshot'
  AND e.topic LIKE 'private:state:%:snapshot'
  AND COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown'), e.ts DESC
)
SELECT
  exchange,
  asset,
  (balance->>'free')::double precision AS free,
  (balance->>'locked')::double precision AS locked,
  (balance->>'total')::double precision AS total,
  ts AS snapshot_time
FROM latest
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(payload->'balances', '{}'::jsonb)) AS b(asset, balance)
ORDER BY exchange, asset

panels.title: Latest account balances
panels.description: Most recent wallet balances per asset from PrivateStateSnapshot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  e.ts AS time,
  COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown') || ' ' || asset AS metric,
  (balance->>'total')::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(e.payload->'balances', '{}'::jsonb)) AS b(asset, balance)
WHERE e.event_type = 'PrivateStateSnapshot'
  AND e.topic LIKE 'private:state:%:snapshot'
  AND COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Open orders
panels.description: Live open order count tracked by the venue ledger service.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$'), 'unknown'), COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol', 'unknown'))
    COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$'), 'unknown') AS exchange,
    COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol', 'unknown') AS symbol,
    e.ts,
    e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'VenueLedgerSnapshot'
  AND e.topic LIKE 'ledger:snapshot:%'
  AND COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$'), 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$'), 'unknown'), COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol', 'unknown'), e.ts DESC
)
SELECT
  exchange,
  symbol,
  (payload->>'available_base')::double precision AS available_base,
  (payload->>'locked_base')::double precision AS locked_base,
  (payload->>'available_quote')::double precision AS available_quote,
  (payload->>'locked_quote')::double precision AS locked_quote,
  jsonb_object_length(COALESCE(payload->'open_orders', '{}'::jsonb)) AS open_orders,
  ts AS snapshot_time
FROM latest
ORDER BY exchange, symbol

panels.title: Latest venue ledger
panels.description: Most recent per-symbol trading ledger snapshot.

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(
      exchange,
      payload->>'exchange',
      substring(topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'),
      substring(topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$')
    ) AS exchange,
    ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

list.definition:
SELECT interval_ms
FROM (
  SELECT interval_ms, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) AS interval_ms, ts AS latest_ts
    FROM mm_events
    WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT interval_ms::text AS interval_ms, ts AS latest_ts
    FROM mm_market_facts
    WHERE interval_ms IS NOT NULL
  ) sources
  GROUP BY interval_ms
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
